color-neutral-100a.$description: Ink #101418 at 5% alpha — the transparent equivalent of neutral-100 on white. Use for shadows, scrims and overlays.

color-neutral-200a.$description: Ink #101418 at 8% alpha — the transparent equivalent of neutral-200 on white. Use for shadows, scrims and overlays.

color-neutral-300a.$description: Ink #101418 at 14% alpha — the transparent equivalent of neutral-300 on white. Use for shadows, scrims and overlays.

color-neutral-500a.$description: Ink #101418 at 32% alpha — the transparent equivalent of neutral-500 on white. Use for shadows, scrims and overlays.

color-neutral-800a.$description: Ink #101418 at 72% alpha — the transparent equivalent of neutral-800 on white. Use for shadows, scrims and overlays.

border-radius-2xs.$description: 2,089 uses — 84% of every radius in the back office. Table cells, dense chips, checkboxes.

border-radius-md.$description: 428 uses. Cards, panels, image tiles — the default card radius.

border-width-05.$description: Hairline. Retina dividers only — not yet used in the product.

border-width-1.$description: 1,623 uses — 94% of every stroke in the file. The default.

border-width-4.$description: Emphasis bars and active tab underline.

size-icon-2xs.$description: Icon box 12px. No measured baseline in the master file — every icon there is an unnamed vector.

size-icon-xs.$description: Icon box 16px. No measured baseline in the master file — every icon there is an unnamed vector.

size-icon-xl.$description: Icon box 40px. No measured baseline in the master file — every icon there is an unnamed vector.

color-neutral-900a.$description: Scrim behind modals and drawers. 55% alpha.
